title: fix(components): interpolate() no-token fast path skips its own trim
body:
Fixes #9174

## What

`interpolate()` (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`) trimmed and
whitespace-collapsed the token path's output but returned its no-token fast path
**verbatim**. A whitespace-only authored `page:header` title (e.g. `'   '`) has no
`{token}`, so it survived that early return unchanged — truthy — and
`PageHeaderRenderer`'s `{explicitTitle && <h1>}` gate drew a **blank `h1`**. Because
`literalTitleText` (`page.tsx`), which decides whether `PageRenderer` delegates its own
heading to the authored header, already trims and correctly read "no title",
`PageRenderer` also drew its own implicit heading — **two `h1` elements on one
document**, the broken outline objectui#3434 closed, arriving through a different door.

Both halves reproduced exactly as the card described, on the `regions[].components`
array-arity channel:

| authored `title` | `h1` count before | `h1` count after |
|---|---|---|
| `'   '` (whitespace only, no token) | 2 | 1 |
| `'Welcome to the CRM'` (lit control) | 1 | 1 (unchanged) |

## Fix

Per the card's suggested route: removed the divergence rather than adding a second trim
call. The no-`{` fast path still skips the `replace()` token-substitution callback (the
actual performance saving it exists for — most authored titles/subtitles have no token
at all, so this still avoids a regex-with-callback pass on every one of them), but
*every* template — token or not — now falls through to the **same single** trim /
whitespace-collapse call at the end, so the two branches are structurally unable to
disagree about whitespace again.

```ts
const out = template.includes('{')
  ? template.replace(/\{([a-zA-Z0-9_.]+)\}/g, (_m, path) => { /* unchanged */ })
  : template;
return out.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
```

## Tests

Two new pins in `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-single-h1.test.tsx`, in the
same accessible-tree style as the rest of that "one page, one `h1`" (objectui#3434)
suite:

- a whitespace-only `page:header` title now renders exactly **one** `h1` (the page's
  own) — reproduced failing (2 `h1`s, one blank) against the pre-fix code, now passing;
- a normal, non-empty title still renders verbatim through the untouched fast path (the
  lit control the card scope asked for).

## Scope

Kept to the helper and its test file, per the card's scope note. Did not touch
`packages/components/src/ui/**` or the `icons` record (not needed — the fix is entirely
inside `interpolate()`/`page-single-h1.test.tsx`), so the in-flight work on the eager
icon closure (objectui#9204/#9251) and registration families (objectui#9256) in this
same package is undisturbed.

## Acceptance notes

None beyond the card — no new out-of-scope findings surfaced while reproducing or
fixing this.
